scope.summary: The supplied build uses the non-integer encoder branch. The sole addition is in the excluded integer-only branch, so it creates no obligation for this target under the fixed recipe. No candidate blockers were supplied or established.

assessments.reason: The added function pointer is inside the FLAC__INTEGER_ONLY_LIBRARY branch. The complete supplied CMake configuration does not define that macro; the target links that CMake-built libFLAC. Its reachable encoding path uses the existing non-integer declaration.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete libFLAC CMake recipe builds stream_encoder.c without defining the integer-only macro.
The complete generated-header template contains no integer-only definition.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The entry invokes the CLI on its temporary input file.

build.reason: The fixed recipe builds and links the CMake libFLAC target and CLI objects. Its supplied configuration selects the unchanged non-integer declaration; this is a static compatibility assessment, not a claimed build result.

evidence.dependency_reason: This recipe includes stream_encoder.c in the linked FLAC library and supplies no integer-only definition.
The changed field is confined to the other preprocessor branch.

input.reason: The entry turns bounded, NUL-delimited prefixes into CLI arguments and writes the remaining fuzz bytes to the file passed to main_to_fuzz; short inputs return before setup.

evidence.dependency_reason: The CLI parses those arguments and records the file operand.

lifecycle.reason: The entry closes and removes its temporary input; main_to_fuzz frees options. On the encoding route, the session creates the encoder and finishes or destroys it through the supplied success and error paths.

evidence.dependency_reason: main_to_fuzz frees per-call options after dispatch.
EncoderSession_construct creates the encoder and EncoderSession_destroy closes and deletes session resources.
Both encoding completion paths call EncoderSession_destroy.

control_flow.reason: Successful option parsing reaches do_it; encoding dispatch reaches flac__encode_file, encoder initialization, sample processing, and finish. The changed integer-only field is excluded by the fixed configuration, while the non-integer field remains available on this route.

evidence.dependency_reason: do_it selects encoding and passes recorded files to encode_file.
encode_file delegates supported input formats to flac__encode_file.
flac__encode_file initializes the encoder before processing samples.
EncoderSession_process invokes the stream encoder process operation.
Encoder initialization assigns the wide predictor pointer used on the selected branch.
Subframe processing chooses the wide predictor under its sample-width guard.

scope.prior_alarm_resolution: The earlier uncertainty about FLAC__INTEGER_ONLY_LIBRARY is resolved by the complete supplied CMake and generated-header sources. The supplied CLI and encoder bodies also resolve the requested entry-to-encoder route.
